name: Devouring Plague
summary: Across the sea from Lordaeron, Devouring Plague awaits Forsaken priests ready to learn its dark art. Miles Welsh in Thunder Bluff sends the adept to Aelthalyste in the Ruins of Lordaeron for this signature Shadow magic.

sections.title: A Summons Home
sections.body: In Thunder Bluff, Miles Welsh trains Forsaken priests among the tauren. He watches their divine and shadowy studies, and knows when an acolyte is ready for higher mysteries. Rather than teach those secrets himself in Kalimdor, Miles sends the worthy back to the Ruins of Lordaeron.

sections.title: The Secrets of Aelthalyste
sections.body: Aelthalyste waits beneath the city ruins in the Undercity's War Quarter. She is one of the foremost mentors of the Forsaken priesthood, guiding acolytes who weave shadow. Devouring Plague drains its victim and carries a corruptive force. Aelthalyste teaches it only to those able to wield that force without succumbing.

faq.q: Who sends you on this quest?
faq.answer: Miles Welsh sends you from the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff when your abilities have developed enough. He is a Forsaken priest trainer stationed among the tauren.
Aelthalyste is in the Undercity's War Quarter, among the training rings and dark conduits where Forsaken priests gather.

faq.q: Why can't Miles Welsh teach the spell himself?
faq.answer: Every priest learns Devouring Plague from a priest trainer at level 20. Miles honors the Forsaken priesthood's hierarchy by sending worthy adepts home to the Undercity, where Aelthalyste can test them.

faq.q: What is Devouring Plague from a lore perspective?
faq.answer: Devouring Plague is a devastating curse practiced by Forsaken priests. Its virulent magic consumes a victim's vitality and restores the caster.

faq.q: Is this quest available to other races?
aliases: can trolls do devouring plague quest
faq.answer: No. This summons is for Forsaken priests, though priests of every race learn Devouring Plague from a priest trainer at level 20.

faq.q: Why is a Forsaken trainer in Thunder Bluff in the first place?
aliases: why are undead in thunder bluff
faq.answer: After the Forsaken joined the Horde, its capitals exchanged diplomats and mentors. Miles Welsh represents the Undercity's spiritual traditions and guides Forsaken traveling through Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a Forsaken priest, you reach an important milestone in your education. You move beyond the basic tenets and learn the dread Shadow traditions unique to the undead.
As a Forsaken, you embrace harsh afflictions and Shadow magic such as Devouring Plague, unlike the Light you practiced in life.
As a member of the Horde, you are bound to distant outposts in Mulgore by spiritual and practical ties reaching back to the Undercity.
